General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, householders' names, and forested areas.

General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, householders' names, and forested areas. Hand colored to emphasize town boundaries and map insets. Relief shown by hachures. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1852 by Robert P. Smith in the ... Eastern District of Pennsylvania." LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, quartered to enable folding. Includes statistical tables (including municipal populations), insets of Rome/Utica cities (showing building coverage), 9 village insets, illustrations of prominent buildings/waterfalls, and key to abbreviations.
